notes.title: Re: Gals Panic 2 Released – Re: Gals Panic Now 50% Off for a Limited Time!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for the incredible support of Re: Gals Panic! The highly anticipated sequel, Re: Gals Panic 2, is officially out now!

This new title not only continues the thrilling gameplay of the original, but also introduces a [b]completely new cast of characters[/b] and [b]dynamic CG animations[/b], delivering a more dazzling visual experience.
From angels to demons, ninjas to mages—their secrets await your discovery.
To celebrate the launch, we’re running a[b] two-week limited-time discount[/b]—don’t miss your chance to grab it!
Also, the first Re: Gals Panic will also be available at [b]50% off [/b]for two weeks, starting from June 2nd at 9:00 AM (PDT).

If you haven't experienced it yet, now's the perfect time to collect both and fully enjoy the world of Re: Gals Panic![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3673900/2/
